description: This file defines the Coupon model class for the OpenCart system, responsible for retrieving coupon data and counts from the database with filtering options.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: A model class for handling coupon report data, providing methods to fetch coupon statistics and totals based on filtering criteria.

methods.name: getCoupons
methods.description: Retrieves a list of coupons with statistics such as number of orders and total amount, filtered by date range and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCoupons
methods.description: Returns the total count of coupons based on optional date filters.
